title: specularia speculum-veneris
intro: Specularia speculum-veneris, commonly known as Foxglove-beauty or beauty flower, is a plant species in the family Campanulaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax the smooth muscles, reduce spasms, and alleviate coughs. Bioactive constituents of Specularia speculum-veneris include flavonoids, glycosides, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
